name: Tethys Sky Routes & Floating Islands
notes: Sky-oases above the Tethys Sea. The islands are held up by lodestone cores of hyper-magnetised, Permian-irradiated ore that repels the Earth's field into localised anti-gravity bubbles, a legacy of the shattering of Gondwana; warped gravity on the undersides sends rainwater overflowing upward as inverted waterfalls. Home to the bark-skinned Vyom-Yakshis, the Cognitavi Cloud-Hermits and their monasteries, and traded by orca-blimp mariners.
biomes_note: Deliberately empty. Sky species have no equivalent among the ten ground biomes, so everything filed here is held as lore and never placed on a tile.
